Class Table

java.lang.Object
msfx.lib.md.Table
public class Table extends Object
A database table, with its columns and indexes.

A column belongs to one table only: when added, the table becomes its owner, and adding it to another table is rejected. Columns are added under their name, never under a different alias, and names must be unique in the table, ignoring case.

To avoid incompatibilities among databases, the only unique index is the primary key; secondary indexes are never unique. Index names must be unique in the table, ignoring case, and two indexes can not have the same columns in the same order. An index not named when assigned is named after the table: TABLE_PK for the primary key, and TABLE_SKn for the secondary indexes.

Author:
Miquel Sas

    • setPrimaryKey

      public void setPrimaryKey(Index index)
      Sets the primary key, replacing the current one if any. The index becomes unique, and is named TABLE_PK if it has no name. A replaced primary key is no longer unique.
      Parameters:
      index - The index to set as primary key.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - If the index is null.
      IllegalArgumentException - If the index belongs to another table, has no columns, has the name or the columns of another index, or any of its columns is nullable.

    • addIndex

      public void addIndex(Index index)
      Adds a secondary index. The index is not unique, and is named TABLE_SKn if it has no name, where n is its position among the secondary indexes, or the next free number.
      Parameters:
      index - The index to add.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - If the index is null.
      IllegalArgumentException - If the index belongs to another table, has no columns, or has the name or the columns of another index.

    • getIndexes

      public List<Index> getIndexes()

      public List<Index> getAllIndexes()
